feeds.title: Hey Pretty
feeds.description: The most exciting novelties from beauty, style, and hair, hand-picked and occasionally peppered with curse words. By Steffi Hidber - beauty industry insider.

feeds.title: The Angelones
feeds.description: I'm Rita. From A for work to Z for braces - I tell true stories from our multi-faceted life as an Italian-Swiss family. There are also recipes, craft ideas, excursion tips and socio-political food for thought to discuss. In the main roles of my stories: my boys - 'the big one' (14) and 'the little one' (11) - as well as my husband. Our blog is a collaborative effort in which we all participate.

feeds.title: Mamas Unplugged
feeds.description: Bloggers from all over Switzerland write for the Swiss parenting platform Mamas Unplugged, who express themselves without make-up (which can sometimes also apply physically) about their mommy existence. We are united by the will to live authentic parenthood, to write and talk about it and to offer a platform for everyone who would rather live imperfectly than not at all.

feeds.title: Family First Switzerland
feeds.description: Family First is an independent web platform for families with kids and one of the leading family blogs of Switzerland in English and German. Founded by an inspired mom of two from Zurich.

feeds.title: Swiss Family Fun
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Tanya, a writer, explorer and mother of two, based in Zürich Switzerland. Since 2005, I've been cataloging the family-friendly hikes and other activities we've done in Switzerland and beyond on this website, helping hundreds of families enjoy the best of Switzerland.

feeds.title: Mama Times 3
feeds.description: I am Tamara, a mother of three with great commitment to bond-oriented parenting, a trained journalist & PR specialist, permanently tired, introverted and authentic. This is a very personal mom blog for a Liechtenstein resident abroad in Switzerland with three children.

feeds.title: Mama on the rocks
feeds.description: I am Séverine, a member of the over 40s club and a mother of LadyGaga (11) and Copperfield (6). I blog about children, careers and collapse - just compatibility.

feeds.title: Chez Mama Poule
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Ellen! I live in Zurich with my two children (3 & 5). I am a freelance journalist and write about a life with children on an equal footing.

feeds.title: Swiss Lark
feeds.description: I'm Lindsey, a former expat in Zurich, living with my husband and two children in the beautiful Pacific Northwest. Swiss Lark is a lifestyle blog covering all things expat and repat life, including homesickness and reverse culture shock. I also throw in some travel, beauty and design, and motherhood.

feeds.title: Fräulein Tiger
feeds.description: My name is Olivia, I am 30 years old, full-time mom of two little boys with all my heart since 2015, I am happily married to my childhood sweetheart and blog here as Miss Tiger. I give you a glimpse into my everyday life with a child.

feeds.title: Mom does not have time at the moment…
feeds.description: I'm Katharina Bleuer and I like to write. My strengths are well-researched, scientifically sound texts in understandable German. This is one of the oldest mommy blogs in Switzerland. The topics range from health, upbringing, family policy, environmental issues, books, guides and much more.

feeds.title: Ana Just Ana
feeds.description: I'm Ana Paula Tediosi. In a world where your titles are as important as the dress you are wearing, I should present myself as Pharmacist with more then 10 year experience in the pharmaceutical industry, founder of Birdhaus Writing & Publishing, former Female ONG leader, working mom Blogger and author. Find interviews with working moms, book reviews, discussions about career and self development.

feeds.title: mal ehrlich
feeds.description: Any Working Mom is a platform for self-determined and equal mothers and fathers - and everyone who wants to become one.
